ai_shield_cache.ai_market_brief: US equity markets are facing significant pressure as investors navigate a combination of sticky inflation, aggressive monetary tightening, and rising geopolitical instability. The confluence of surging Treasury yields and potential energy supply disruptions has created a volatile environment, prompting increased caution among market participants.
